nodes.label: Time Sheet Import Feature
nodes.rationale: Allows an admin to upload a season's Google-Sheets time-tracker CSV and parse, validate, preview, and import it into session/excusal rows idempotently, tagged source='import'. Designed with a pure parser and impure runner to enable unit testing, mirroring the roster-import pattern.

nodes.label: Student Application Import Feature
nodes.rationale: Imports Google Forms Student Application CSV responses into the roster: enriches person, populates a guardian many-to-many model, and records prior-FIRST experience. Uses header-mapping not position-based parsing to handle column drift across years.

nodes.label: Google Drive Group Sync Feature
nodes.rationale: Teams linked 1:1 to Google Workspace Groups; membership changes sync in real time; nightly reconcile adds missing members and reports would-be removals without auto-removing, except on explicit team-leave.

nodes.label: Multi-Email Identities Feature
nodes.rationale: One person can sign in with multiple Google accounts while remaining a single person. Expand-contract rollout: person_identity table added first, person.auth_user_id dropped last. person.email is the primary-email control knob mirrored by trigger.

nodes.label: Merge Duplicate People Feature
nodes.rationale: Admin dashboard surfaces likely duplicates ranked by name similarity; atomic plpgsql merge_person function reassigns all FK references, moves identities, records alias, deletes loser. Importers consult alias table to prevent re-creating merged persons.
